pr_body:
The cluster health transport action may wait for cluster state to
change, moving execution momentarily onto the master service and
cluster state applier threads. When execution resumes, it must be
moved back onto MANAGEMENT threads, to avoid performing
computationally heavy work on hot path threads.

Fixes #96544

issue_context.title: Cluster health computation sometimes runs on applier thread
issue_context.body: In https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/90621 we moved most usages of the cluster health API onto a `MANAGEMENT` thread because it's too expensive to run on `SAME` in a large cluster. However, if the request includes any `wait_for_*` option then we set up a cluster state observer, which supplies its responses on the cluster applier thread. We need to fork those computations onto a `MANAGEMENT` thread too.

review_comments: Hmm in two of the call sites `onNewClusterStateAfterDelay` is lightweight (it calls `waitForEventsAndExecuteHealth` which just submits a task to the master service) so forking here shouldn't be necessary. It's only the one call in `masterOperation` which needs to fork.
Seems to fail in [this CI test](https://elasticsearch-ci.elastic.co/job/elastic+elasticsearch+pull-request+part-1/40761/consoleFull) at least. Would it be better to fork also this one?
Yup, I missed a place originally. Fixed! Thanks
